Requirement: Loss of AI shall not stop basic plant operation.
AI shall never bypass existing safety controls or interlocks.
Risk scoring shall meet the agreed process-response window.
The system shall degrade safely when data or dependencies fail.
Operational recommendations shall include interpretable evidence.
Predictions shall link to source data, feature set, code and model version.
OT integration shall use segmented least-privilege pathways.
Manufacturing evidence shall be protected from unauthorized alteration.
Human and machine decisions shall be logged and attributable.
Architecture shall scale across additional assets, lines and plants.
Interfaces shall minimize machine-vendor and cloud-provider coupling.
Data, service and model health shall be measurable end-to-end.
Critical services shall support deterministic restore/rollback.
Schemas, pipelines, code and models shall be independently versioned.
Core models/contracts shall not depend on one equipment vendor.
Stale, missing, duplicated, misordered or invalid telemetry shall be identified.
Alerting shall be managed by severity, budget and actionability.
Cross-system time shall support reliable event reconstruction.
Model promotion shall require pre-defined evidence gates.
AI failure shall revert to existing approved operating procedures.
